title: Launch: Hedgehog Lane — Slate & Deployment Logbook (Oct 2026, WIP)
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact operational slate and logbook for the 'Hedgehog Lane' soft-launch. It is intentionally opinionated: a single-page-ish run-of-ops for launch-day operators, SRE, and product owners who need a fast mental model.

Status: draft — working checklist and minute-by-minute anchor. Do not treat as canonical until sign-off from Release Steward and SRE lead.

Summary of change:
- Ship frontend feature flag gating for session-based routing (client-side rollouts).
- Roll backend routing that introduces model-variant B for low-cost inference in Dedicated pools.
- Telemetry: new sampling for latency p50/p95 by route, plus token-cost delta metric.

Launch windows and cadence:
- Quiet window (no external customer campaigns): 2026-10-12 01:00–05:00 PDT
- Micro-canary start: 01:10 PDT — 0.5% traffic to Hedgehog lane (EU region only)
- Expansion stages: 0.5% -> 2% in 30m steps (monitoring checks at each step)
- Stabilization hold: 60m after reaching 2%
- Ramp to 10% (if all green) across regions with cross-region stagger of 15m
- Full roll (if green across metrics and business owners sign off) targeted within 6 hours

Operator roles (on-call roster for the window):
- Release Steward: Asha Menon (primary contact)
- SRE Lead: Ethan Zhao (telemetry + rollback authority)
- Backend Owner: Tom Becker (routing + model toggles)
- Frontend Owner: María Alvarez (FF gating + client rollout)
- Observability SME (backup): Priya Das
- On-call rotation: see linked roster in Slack /ops/roster

Quick preflight checklist (T-minus 24h -> T-minus 1h):
- [ ] Confirm smoke-test harness PR merged (ops/pull/789) and CI green
- [ ] Verify canary dataset seeded in staging and sample prompts validated by product
- [ ] Ensure capacity reservations for Dedicated pools (vCPU/GPU quotas) validated with infra (ticket: INFRA-621)
- [ ] Confirm KMS key policies for private customer logs (security review signed)
- [ ] Pre-populate rollback runbook snippets in the incident doc (link in artifacts)

T-minus 1h: Launch-night final checks:
- [ ] Notify stakeholders in #release-ops and send 15m preflight ping
- [ ] Confirm dashboard quick-links are open and sourcing live metrics (latency, qps, error-rate, token-cost-delta)
- [ ] Tail the last 15m of staging smoke logs for unexpected regressions
- [ ] Boot an adhoc queries node for fast postmortem search

Minute-by-minute play (first 90m):
- 00:00 — Record start time in logbook. Switch feature flag to micro-canary target 0.5% EU.
- 00:05 — Verify canary-ing calls are hitting Hedgehog lane using request-tagging header (X-HH-Canary)
- 00:10 — Check latency p50/p95 by route. Confirm no >2x p95 increase. If p95 >2x, pause and investigate.
- 00:15 — Snapshot token-cost-delta and model-output-quality quick eval (3 prompts). If quality regression > threshold, initiate rollback.
- 00:30 — Expand to 1% if all green. Run a longer sampling job (1000 requests) for sampling metrics.
- 01:00 — Expand to 2% and enter stabilization hold for 60m. Run automated eval harness and manual spot checks.

Telemetry and success signals (primary and secondary):
Primary signals (must be green to expand):
- Request success rate >= 99.95%
- p95 latency: <= baseline * 1.5 (region-specific)
- Token-cost-delta: within expected +/- 8%
- Sampled quality eval pass rate >= 98% for curated prompt set

Secondary signals (watch for but not immediate blockers):
- CPU/GPU spillover on dedicated nodes
- Spike in errors with specific stack traces (model OOMs, timeout 504s)
- Downstream dependency latencies (DB, auth) rising >20%

Fallback and rollback matrix (fast options):
- Fast rollback (0–5m): flip feature flag to previous stable client variant — immediate traffic rebind to global baseline routing.
- Route-level rollback (5–20m): scale Hedgehog lane to 0% via routing policy in control plane; maintain detailed sampling logs for RCA.
- Model-flip rollback (10–30m): replace model-variant B with model-variant A using runtime model aliasing; verify KV cache warmup impact.
- Emergency abort (manual): coordinate with SRE Lead and Exec on-call; open incident channel and escalate to SEs for hotfix.

Runbooks snippets (copy-paste candidates):
- "Flip HH FF": /ops/ff/hedgehog/roll-back -> set fraction to 0.0, confirm traffic shift in 30s
- "Model alias swap": /ops/models/alias -> point alias 'inference-current' -> 'model-A-v12', restart router workers in one locality
- "Telemetry snapshot": run scripts/tele-snap.sh --window=10m --routes=hedgehog -> upload to incident doc

Observability quick-links (open in tab before start):
- Canary dashboard: /dashboards/canary-hedgehog
- Error-trace sampler: /traces?service=inference&tag=hedgehog
- Cost delta chart: /dashboards/token-cost-delta
- Smoke-tests live results: /ci/pipelines/ops-smoke/789/stream

Post-expansion checklist (after full roll):
- [ ] Confirm long-tail p99s are within SLA for 24h
- [ ] Sweep logs for slow-dependence or auth anomalies
- [ ] Schedule 72h follow-up with Product for quality metrics and customer-facing notes
- [ ] Run nightly full-eval job on production sample and compare to baseline for drift

Annotated release notes (draft for product / marketing):
- Short summary: Hedgehog Lane introduces a low-cost inference variant routed for exploratory sessions. It reduces per-token cost for non-critical flows while preserving baseline quality for production routes.
- Rollout: staged across regions beginning 2026-10-12; start with EU micro-canary.
- Impact: expected average token cost reduction ~12% on targeted routes; negligible latency change under normal load.
- Notes: Customers in Dedicated plans will see variant routing only if customer flag enabled; no change to private-deployed control planes without opt-in.

Open questions / risky assumptions (discussion items):
- Can model-variant B handle longer tail conversational histories without degrading quality? (Need 48h sample)
- Does KV cache warming materially increase p95 during rapid ramps? (Hypothesis: minor bump, but we need a metric guardrail)
- Are there any untested third-party integrations that rely on exact tokenization counts?

Dirty notes / operator tips (freeform):
- If you see a 504 pattern with 'kv cache miss' tag, try a staged restart of worker pods in that AZ first before global rollback.
- During EU night window, watch auth service latencies — recent config change INFRA-593 introduced an extra call.
- Keep a running log of manual checks with timestamps; it makes postmortem blunter and faster.

Appendix: short checklist to paste into incident page
- Start time: ______
- Canary fraction steps and timestamps:
  - 0.5% at: _____
  - 1.0% at: _____
  - 2.0% at: _____
- Observability snapshots attached: [ ]
- Rollback executed: Y/N  If Y, short reason: ____

End of slate.

If anything is unclear or you want a condensed one-page 'operator pocket' version, I'll produce a minimal two-column card for handoff to on-call.
short_summary: Hedgehog Lane staged rollout slate: micro-canary -> staged expansion -> telemetry guards -> rollback matrix. Draft for ops and product.
file_notes: WIP — final signoff required from SRE lead and Product by 2026-10-10. Keep this doc as the living log during the window.
